name: 14_calin_jessy_theo
scene: Puis ils se prennent dans les bras. Pour toi, mille ans. Pour nous, quelques secondes.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE full-screen visual novel CG, landscape 16:9, requested output 1920 x 1080 pixels, opaque full-bleed illustration.
Primary request: A beautiful, deeply moving farewell embrace between Jessy and Theo in the Capitol square just before Theo leaves for a 999-year jump into the future. Jessy will stay behind, ageless, to guide humanity and build the ship that will await his friends. For Theo their separation will last seconds; for Jessy it will last a thousand years. Capture two friends holding each other firmly, struggling to let go. Quiet affection, fear of separation, trust, gratitude, and the weight of a promise. The same warm melancholic emotional atmosphere as the previous Laplage farewell CG.
Input images: Image 1 is THEO identity and wardrobe reference. Image 2 is JESSY identity and wardrobe reference. Image 3 is the exact CAPITOL SQUARE location and departure-era continuity reference. Image 4 is the Laplage farewell image, a LIGHTING / MOOD / PAINTERLY ANIME STYLE reference ONLY; its elderly character and beach must NOT appear.
Characters: THEO is the older man from image 1, around sixty, swept-back short salt-and-pepper gray hair, a neat gray mustache, black rectangular glasses, no full beard, beige trench coat over a charcoal ribbed turtleneck and dark trousers. A small green blocky creeper keychain hangs from his coat as in reference 1, visible only if it naturally fits the embrace, never duplicated. He is NOT Monsieur Laplage: do not replace his bespectacled face with the white-haired elderly man from reference 4. JESSY remains a young adult man of about twenty, brown tousled hair, a SHORT full brown beard, black rectangular glasses, simple ivory-white priest's robe with the exact standing clerical collar of image 2. No long prophet beard, no gem pendant: those belong to a future scene.
Composition/framing: intimate medium shot from about hip height up, two figures together at center with generous landscape breathing room at the sides. Theo to the left and Jessy to the right, facing inward toward each other in a natural firm mutual embrace. Angle their bodies and heads so that both three-quarter faces are visible, one over the other's shoulder, never squashing their glasses together. Theo closes his eyes in a pained tender expression; Jessy's eyes glisten behind his glasses, his brow betrays how afraid he is to be left behind, a tiny trembling grateful smile rather than broad happiness. Jessy's hand gently grips the back of Theo's beige coat at the shoulder blade; Theo's arm wraps securely around Jessy's upper back, his visible hand rests on the ivory robe. Anatomically coherent two men, four arms, believable shoulders, normal hands, no extra hands, no fused fingers. Their faces and the key shoulder / hand contact remain in the upper two-thirds. Lower quarter is quiet robe and coat fabric with subdued paving to accommodate a future dialogue box, but DO NOT draw a dialogue box.
Scene/backdrop: faithfully reinterpret the square in reference 3 from a closer camera: rebuilt retro-futurist Capitol with bronze-gold architectural ribs, monumental steps, dark red ceremonial banners, distant port city and ocean, pink alien vegetation. The cheering departure crowd and parade remain small, softly blurred at the far sides and on the steps, so this feels like an intimate pocket of silence amid a public ceremony. No other principal characters. Both low suns may be seen through the open left side of the square: a larger muted orange-red disc and a smaller golden disc over the distant sea. No TARDIS yet: it materializes after the hug. This is the DEPARTURE era, not the much grander 999-years-later city, no thumbs-up cult symbols.
Lighting/mood: lyrical late-sunset amber and peach light gently rims the two friends' hair, glasses, coat and white robe, delicate warm reflections on the paving, soft violet shadows and mauve cloud sky. Match reference 4's radiant, finely painted cinematic atmosphere while keeping the faces legible and natural. Emotion is deeply sincere, restrained and bittersweet, a farewell between friends with a vast future between them. No romantic kiss, no comedic expressions, no melodramatic open-mouth crying.
Style/medium: richly detailed illustrated anime CG with fine precise lines, natural adult proportions, expressive dimensional faces, painterly atmospheric backgrounds, beautiful cinematic light matching reference 4 and the established game's CGs. Repaint both characters as fully integrated people embracing in the environment; no pasted sprite look, no photorealism or 3D.
Constraints: ONE independent complete illustration, no collage, no panels, no borders, no text, no written dialogue, no captions, no readable signage, no interface, no watermark.
export: Bicubic resize, no crop. Original preserved.
